evals.prompt: babysit PR #742 until green. CodeRabbit has comments and CI is red.
evals.expected_output: A pass-based PR loop: resolve PR, poll checks and unresolved threads, fetch failing logs, verify comments before edits, push once if fixes are made, and end with DONE, NOT YET, or BLOCKED.

evals.prompt: This PR is still pending CI after my push. Can you watch it and fix anything that fails?
evals.expected_output: The skill should poll current checks, avoid speculative edits while checks are pending, wait or report NOT YET, and only root-cause failures once they actually fail.

evals.prompt: CodeRabbit says our migration backfill is not idempotent on this PR. Please handle the review thread and get it green.
evals.expected_output: The skill should verify the review comment against actual migration code, apply migration-safety principles for idempotency and clean-start proof, fix or dispute the comment, and report PR loop status.

evals.prompt: babysit this branch, I think it just needs a PR and then wait for checks
evals.expected_output: If no PR exists, the skill should inspect branch cleanliness and ahead commits, offer or perform PR creation through the repo workflow when clearly requested, then continue polling checks/review comments in the same pass instead of stopping prematurely.
